```{r Use gbif to assign ranges to SUBSET of species}
Subset_species$SpRange_Lat.Min<- c(NA)
Subset_species$SpRange_Lat.Max<- c(NA)

# Function to get latitudinal range from GBIF
get_lat_range <- function(species_name) {

  # If empty or NA
  if (is.na(species_name) || species_name == "") return(c(NA, NA))

  # Query GBIF taxonomy
  bb <- name_backbone(name = species_name)

  # If GBIF cannot match the name
  if (is.null(bb$usageKey)) return(c(NA, NA))

  # Extract GBIF key
  key <- bb$usageKey

  # Query GBIF occurrences (limit small for testing)
  occ <- occ_search(
    taxonKey = key,
    hasCoordinate = TRUE,
    limit = 300
  )

  # If no data returned
  if (is.null(occ$data) || nrow(occ$data) == 0) return(c(NA, NA))

  lat <- occ$data$decimalLatitude

  return(c(min(lat, na.rm = TRUE), max(lat, na.rm = TRUE)))
}

# Apply to your species list
lat_ranges <- map(Subset_species$estimated_species_name, get_lat_range)

# Convert list of pairs to two numeric vectors
ranges_df <- do.call(rbind, lat_ranges)

Subset_species$SpRange_Lat.Min <- ranges_df[,1]
Subset_species$SpRange_Lat.Max <- ranges_df[,2]
```

```{r Use gbif to assign species ranges to ALL OF CONAPESCA data}
CONAPESCA_SpKey_filtered$SpRange_Lat.Min<- c(NA)
CONAPESCA_SpKey_filtered$SpRange_Lat.Max<- c(NA)

plan(multisession, workers = 2)  # only 2 cores to avoid throttling

species_list <- CONAPESCA_SpKey_filtered$estimated_species_name
#species_list <- Subset_species$estimated_species_name

lat_ranges_list <- future_lapply(
  species_list, 
  function(sp) {
    tryCatch({
      get_lat_range_safe(sp, limit = 300)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error for species ", sp, ": ", e$message)
      return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
    })
  },
  future.seed = TRUE  # ensures reproducible results
)

# Combine safely
lat_ranges_df <- do.call(rbind, lat_ranges_list)
colnames(lat_ranges_df) <- c("SpRange_Lat.Min", "SpRange_Lat.Max")

# Attach to your main dataframe
#Subset_species <- cbind(Subset_species, lat_ranges_df)
CONAPESCA_SpKey_filtered <- cbind(CONAPESCA_SpKey_filtered, lat_ranges_df)
```

```{r Find the latitudinal mid point of the range}
# Find the latitudinal mid point of the range

  mutate(SpRange_Center = (SpRange_Lat.Min + SpRange_Lat.Max) / 2)

Subset_species<- Subset_species %>% filter(!is.na(SpRange_Center))
```

```{r Add this info to the landings data}
Sp_of_Interest<- Subset_species %>% filter(!is.na(estimated_species_name)) %>%
  pull(estimated_species_name)

Subset_landings<- GoC_CONAPESCA_data %>% filter(estimated_species_name %in% Sp_of_Interest)
# 803810 obs.

Subset_landings<- Subset_landings %>% select(year, month, state, 
                                         office_name, landing_site, GoC, lat, long,
                                         recorded_taxa_group, estimated_species_name, 
                                         landed_weight, live_weight, value)

Subset_species <- Subset_species %>% select(recorded_taxa_group, estimated_species_name,
                        SpRange_Lat.Min, SpRange_Lat.Max, SpRange_Center)

# Merge landings data to range key data:
Subset_landings_w_ranges <- left_join(
  Subset_species,
  Subset_landings,
  by = c("recorded_taxa_group", "estimated_species_name")
)
```

```{r Actual analysis}
# Weighted average latitude per year
lat_cog <- Subset_landings_w_ranges %>%
  filter(!is.na(SpRange_Center) & !is.na(live_weight)) %>%  # keep valid rows
  filter(state=="SONORA") %>% # let's assume I'm only interested in landings in Sonora
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_lat = sum(SpRange_Center * live_weight) / sum(live_weight),
    total_landings = sum(live_weight)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)


ggplot(lat_cog, aes(x = year, y = weighted_lat)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_point(color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Weighted Average Latitude of Catch Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Weighted Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Download SST data}
library(rerddap)
library(raster)
library(ncdf4)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Connect to the dataset
info <- info("ncdcOisst21Agg_LonPM180")

# 2. Set bounding box (Gulf of California)
lat_range <- c(23, 33)
lon_range <- c(-115, -105)

# 3. Loop over years and request mean(time) for each year
years <- 2000:2024
sst_yearly_files <- list()

for (yr in years) {
  start <- paste0(yr, "-01-01")
  end   <- paste0(yr, "-12-31")
  
  # Server computes the yearly mean
  sst_year <- griddap(info,
                      time = c(start, end),
                      latitude = lat_range,
                      longitude = lon_range,
                      fields = "sst",
                      fmt = "nc",
                      url = "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/")
  
  sst_yearly_files[[as.character(yr)]] <- sst_year$summary$filename
  cat("Downloaded yearly mean SST for", yr, "\n")
}


#### Save these SST files! ####
# Make sure the remote directory exists
dir.create("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/SST_ERDDAP/", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Copy the already-downloaded yearly SST files there
for (yr in years) {
  tmp_file <- sst_yearly_files[[as.character(yr)]]
  remote_file <- paste0("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/spatial/SST_ERDDAP/SST_", yr, ".nc")
  
  file.copy(tmp_file, remote_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # Update the list to point to the remote path
  sst_yearly_files[[as.character(yr)]] <- remote_file
  cat("Saved SST for year", yr, "to", remote_file, "\n")
}
```

```{r Read and extract SST by lat-long}
# Example: read one year
r <- raster(sst_yearly_files[[1]])
plot(r)  # shows SST per grid cell

r_stack <- stack(lapply(sst_yearly_files, raster))
names(r_stack) <- years  # 2000, 2001, ..., 2024

plot(r_stack[[5]])  # e.g., SST for 2004

sst_points <- rasterToPoints(r_stack)
# Columns: long, lat, SST_2000, SST_2001, ..., SST_2024
head(sst_points)

# Function to get SST for a single row
get_sst_for_catch <- function(lat, long, year){
  layer <- which(names(r_stack) == as.character(year))
  if(length(layer) == 0) return(NA)  # year not in raster stack
  extract(r_stack[[layer]], matrix(c(long, lat), ncol=2))
}
```

```{r Add SST to landings data}
library(terra)

# Step 1: Convert each RasterLayer individually
r_list <- lapply(1:nlayers(r_stack), function(i) {
  r <- r_stack[[i]]
  values(r) <- as.numeric(values(r))  # ensure numeric
  rast(r)
})

# Step 2: Stack into a single SpatRaster
r_stack_terra <- rast(r_list)

# Assuming r_stack_terra is a SpatRaster from previous step
names(r_stack_terra) <- 2000:(2000 + nlyr(r_stack_terra) - 1)

# Inspect
r_stack_terra

# Extract SST for all layers
# We'll match each row by year
Subset_landings_w_ranges$SST <- NA_real_
# Convert:
Subset_landings_w_ranges$long <- as.numeric(Subset_landings_w_ranges$long)

# Prepare coordinates as SpatVector
coords <- vect(Subset_landings_w_ranges[, c("long", "lat")],
               geom = c("long","lat"), 
               crs = crs(r_stack_terra))

# Prepare a numeric vector for layer indices
years_in_raster <- 2000:(2000 + nlyr(r_stack_terra) - 1)

# Initialize SST column
Subset_landings_w_ranges$SST <- NA_real_

for (yr in unique(Subset_landings_w_ranges$year)) {
  idx <- which(Subset_landings_w_ranges$year == yr)
  if (length(idx) == 0) next

  # Match year to layer index
  layer_idx <- which(years_in_raster == yr)
  if (length(layer_idx) == 0) next  # skip if year not found

  sst_layer <- r_stack_terra[[layer_idx]]
  Subset_landings_w_ranges$SST[idx] <- terra::extract(sst_layer, coords[idx, ])[,2]
}


# Check
head(Subset_landings_w_ranges$SST)
```

```{r Plot}
# Example: weighted SST per year
sst_yearly <- Subset_landings_w_ranges %>%
  filter(!is.na(SpRange_Center) & !is.na(live_weight) & !is.na(SST)) %>%
  filter(state=="SONORA") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(weighted_SST = sum(SST * live_weight) / sum(live_weight))

# Merge with weighted latitude
lat_cog <- lat_cog %>%
  left_join(sst_yearly, by = "year")

# Determine scaling factor for secondary axis
# We want SST to roughly match the latitude scale on the plot
# e.g., scale factor = max(weighted_lat) / max(weighted_SST)
scale_factor <- max(lat_cog$weighted_lat, na.rm = TRUE) / max(lat_cog$weighted_SST, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
ggplot(lat_cog, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = weighted_lat), color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = weighted_lat), color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = weighted_SST * scale_factor), color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = weighted_SST * scale_factor), color = "red", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Latitudinal Centroid of Total Catch (weighted by landings)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "SST (°C; scaled)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Latitudinal Centroid of Catch vs Temp Over Time",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "blue"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "red")
  )

```
